name: Taming the Beast
summary: Quel'ana Quickgale asks you to tame a galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. Your skill on open ground will prepare you for trials ahead.

sections.title: Across the Plains
sections.body: You've already shown you can tame the river's crawler. Quel'ana Quickgale now gives you a Taming Rod and asks you to seek a galestrider in the lowlands of Zephras. The proud, winged creature runs swiftly across the plains. Earn its trust, practice your skill, and bring the rod back to Quel'ana in Valanaar.

faq.q: What does Quel'ana want me to tame?
faq.answer: Quel'ana asks you to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands.

faq.q: Where do I find the galestrider?
faq.answer: The Ornery Galestrider is in the Gustberry Lowlands, in the plains of Zephras.

faq.q: What is the Taming Rod for?
faq.answer: Quel'ana gives you the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider.
Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar asks you to tame an Ornery Galestrider and return the Taming Rod.
